data.cultural_impact: The name Jankee embraces tradition and India's rich mythological heritage. The belief is that the blessing of the deity, through the name, empowers the child to gain knowledge and understanding of both the material and spiritual worlds. Further, it serves as a constant reminder for the child to uphold the virtues of intellect, enlightenment, and wisdom throughout their life.

The name Janaki is also found in the Puranas, a collection of ancient Indian texts, referring to the goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity.
